deep.reconstruction: Folio 64r contains no mathematics. It is a draft, or the start of a fair copy, of an administrative receipt ('Quittung') in German. Reading it: a faint heading 'zu Michaelis' at the top; then 'Quittung über 150 Thlr Courant', with 'Quittung' inserted above the line; then the incomplete sentence 'Daß ich aus der Königlichen Universitäts-Casse von der mir [bis auf Weiteres / auf Widerruf] bewilligten jährlichen fortlaufenden Remuneration ad 300 Thlr Courant den Betrag auf das Semester von Ostern bis Michaelis 1858 ...'. The sentence breaks off. The standard formula would continue with something like '[mit 150 Thlr richtig] erhalten habe, bescheinige ich hiermit'; this completion is my inference. In plain terms, Riemann acknowledges receiving from the Royal University treasury in Göttingen the half-year instalment, 150 Thaler, of his annual remuneration of 300 Thaler, for the summer semester from Easter to Michaelmas (29 September) 1858. The only 'computation' is the implicit one that a semester instalment is half the annual sum: 300/2 = 150. This matches what biographies report: in November 1857 Riemann was made außerordentlicher Professor at Göttingen with a modest salary of about 300 Thaler per year. The page is a biographical and financial document, not a mathematical one. The surrounding pages hold mathematical scraps: logarithm and integral formulas on the previous page, and on the next page a lecture announcement on complex functions and hypergeometric series together with a hypergeometric-type differential equation in d/dlog x. Riemann evidently reused this paper. Faint bleed-through of text from the verso is visible but illegible and is not part of 64r.
errors: No mathematical errors, because there is no mathematics. The receipt sentence is incomplete: it lacks a main verb such as 'erhalten habe'. That suggests a draft or an abandoned copy.

transcription_corrections: The heading reads 'Quittung über 150 Thlr Courant': 'Quittung' is written above the line and connects to '-über', so the machine's '-über = 150' is a split heading, not an equation.
The insertion above 'bewilligten' is uncertain. It looks more like 'bis auf Weiteres' (or similar) than 'auf Widerruf'; it should be flagged as doubtful.
The line begins 'Daß ich aus der Königlichen Universitäts-Casse ...'; 'Casse' is plausible but not certain from the image.
The sentence is unfinished after '... von Ostern bis Michaelis 1858'; no closing verb is present on the page.
The faint top line 'zu Michaelis' is very pale and is probably correct. The bleed-through text from the verso is not part of this page.
